meta.revisionPolicy: Final on release. Agriculture-year reports (July to June, 2017-18 to 2023-24) and calendar-year estimates (new design, published for 2023 on) are two designs, never joined.
meta.coverage: All India, workers aged 15 and above; percentage distribution by industry (NIC 2008 section and group), by status within each industry group, by enterprise type and size within each group; men, women and all; rural, urban and both; usual status (PS+SS) and current weekly status
meta.note: PLFS annual reports, agriculture years (July to June) plotted at July. Each key names its cut: sec_<letter> is a NIC section, trade/transport/accommodation_food/other_services/tertiary are NIC groups, and a status, enterprise type or size before the group is a distribution of that group's workers. Separate from the calendar-year estimates (services-jobs-cy): a different survey design.
